Title: [JOURNEY] Punchout — buyer reviews a 3-line cart, clicks Create requisition, the ERP receives exactly those lines
Preconditions: Dedicated punchout buyer @td(PUNCHOUT_MAPPING_REQUISITION.externalId) (one organization, own account); Punchout.Enabled on for the configuration-0 store; desktop viewport 1920x1080. Setup resets the buyer to one empty `default` cart. Products are live-discovered, never fixed. --- SCREEN: catalog ---
